description: Base text-to-speech API paid via x402. Converts text input into a hosted audio URL. Dynamic pricing for TTS: the prepaid price is computed per request based on the input and charged upfront via x402. Prepaid price for pure discovery requests without text is an upper bound; clients should re-run discovery with their concrete input if they need an exact quote.
